patterns.what_worked: Dispatching the two live defects to lanes with disjoint file scopes, and owning the one regression I could prove (the font delta) instead of leaving it open.
patterns.what_was_hard: Guessing in the open instead of dispatching; duplicated content across four workshop docs; told the operator the tree was publish-ready before two client-visible behaviours were verified.
patterns.skill_gap: Mirror-constant pins — a harness pin that copies the production constant cannot catch a change to that constant. One such pin hid the font regression. The pattern needs a sweep, not a one-off fix.
